component.name: Nijiyome
component.summary: Anime player with libmpv and local extensions
Reproductor de anime con libmpv y extensiones locales

description.p: Nijiyome on the desktop: browse your library and history, sign in with AniList or MyAnimeList, play episodes with libmpv and Anime4K or FSR upscaling, stream torrents, download episodes, and run sideloaded .kai extensions in a sandboxed host. The same app runs on Android.
Two player modes are available in Settings:

ul.li: Embedded: libmpv drawn inside the app window, with the app controls, upscaling shaders, and built-in LSFG frame generation (zero-copy GL/D3D12 to Vulkan).
External mpv: your own mpv in its own window, with your configuration, the enhanced mode (mpv-anime-build) and frame generation through lsfg-vk.

description.p: Nijiyome en el escritorio: explora tu biblioteca e historial, inicia sesión con AniList o MyAnimeList, reproduce episodios con libmpv y escalado Anime4K o FSR, mira torrents, descarga episodios y ejecuta extensiones .kai locales en un host aislado. La misma app funciona en Android.

Built-in desktop Frame Generation inside the embedded player: LSFG 3.1 / 3.1P now runs directly inside Nijiyome's Compose player (Linux zero-copy OpenGL to Vulkan via OPAQUE_FD, Windows zero-copy Direct3D 12 to Vulkan via shared handles, plus automatic staging fallback) with live Mejoras controls, scene-cut anti-artifacts, automatic audio-delay compensation, and no external mpv window required.

Linux startup fix: packs the desktop classpath into a pathing JAR so the jpackage launcher no longer hits OpenJDK JDK-8380085 (SIGSEGV on launch when mounted from an AppImage or long install path with 200+ JARs).

Full visual redesign across Desktop and Android: five independent visual directions (Tanabata, Obi, Night Transit, Sumi & Hanko, and Material), 16 card styles, curated palettes per direction (light, dark, OLED), and per-screen customizable layouts (Tonight / Stage / Shelves for Home; Panel / Route / Cinema for Details; Week / Departure Board / Agenda / Month for Calendar; Cinema / Panel / Minimal for the player).

Motion system and interaction patterns: configurable motion profiles (Full, Calm, Performance), card-to-Details transitions, optional resting tilt for hanging tanzaku strips, multi-selection with batch actions, live Design Gallery, and five-tab Appearance settings with live poster preview.

Refinements and fixes: bundled jdk.localedata with explicit 24-hour times across Home and Calendar, full multi-page Month calendar loading, full-width Details from Explore/Calendar/Library, compact Cinema episode drawer, in-place Ctrl+K jump inside Settings, and direction-matched control shapes across screens.

Metadata completeness and rate-limit resilience: full episode ladder with automatic MAL ID resolution via ani.zip so Tenrai/MAL episode titles and thumbnails enrich seasonal anime missing details on AniList/Kitsu, plus live animated fallback countdown banners and automatic recovery to the primary metadata provider when cooldown ends.

Torrent discovery and Source Picker filters: AniList synonyms and clean short/hyphen-safe query variants fix 0-result torrent searches for long light-novel titles; new multi-select filters for Debrid cached, Sub, Dub, Dual Audio, Multi-Dub, Multi-Sub, audio track languages, and subtitle languages.

Desktop polish: selectable Anime Details titles with one-click Copy Title and Open in AniList buttons, fixed Linux X11/XWayland _NET_WM_MOVERESIZE union bug and AWT pointer ungrab to eliminate window drag trails, and stabilized system tray menu telemetry with hover-freeze so submenus never flicker on KDE Plasma.

UX/UI overhaul across Desktop and Android: true-black AMOLED (#000000 with subtle hairlines), searchable bilingual Settings with Desktop Master-Detail and Ctrl+P modal, Global Command Palette (Ctrl+K), horizontal scroll fading edges, Home and Anime Details polish, and unified navigation shell.
Desktop window dragging: native OS window move/resize via _NET_WM_MOVERESIZE (X11/XWayland) and WM_NCLBUTTONDOWN (Windows) plus optional native title bar toggle to eliminate compositor artifacts.

Player, Link Monitor and Diagnostics: audio track switching in Media3 and libmpv, structured error logs with mTLS shipping to PC, double torrent selection fix, redesigned Android touch player (Cinema and Minimalist styles, continuous multi-layer buffer seekbar, tactile scrub bubble, vertical gesture bars, landscape side sheets, quick aspect ratio cycling), expanded back-buffer and configurable Link RAM rewind cache (512 MB–4 GB) for instant rewinds without re-processing Anime4K or LSFG, live Desktop Link Monitor with active title bar indicator, and an overhauled system tray menu with Link, torrent, RAM and cache telemetry.
Desktop: frameless window with a custom title bar, status chips (Link port and offline indicator), drag-to-move, double-click maximize and border resizing on Linux and Windows.

Nijiyome Link: fixed Send to device and PC torrent sessions when TorBox is linked on the PC, deterministic Anime4K shader extraction, Vulkan/libplacebo startup probe, automatic LSFG library reload, and sanitized Link and extension server error logging to app.log.

TorBox and Debrid: added Settings › Torrents › Debrid and Library › Torrents empty-state entry points, fixed the startup account loading race, parallelized cache checks with progressive marking, and surfaced the cached TorBox badge in compact Details.
Nijiyome Link now tells paired phones the real app version instead of a fixed one.

The key that protects saved account tokens is now kept in its own keyring item per data folder, so a second data folder can no longer replace the key of the first. On update, the shared key of earlier versions is copied to the folder whose secrets it opens, so nothing has to be linked again.
Saved secrets that cannot be opened are never treated as empty or overwritten: the file is kept aside and Settings › Data asks to link the accounts again.
Nijiyome Link explains when its keys cannot be opened, logs why it did not start, and offers Regenerate identity (the old identity is kept in a backup folder; phones must pair again).
Windows: a subtitle file picked from disk loads again, and torrent streaming no longer serves empty data before a piece reaches the disk.
Windows: the fallback downloads folder no longer shares the download engine's own folder, so resetting the app cannot delete downloaded episodes.
Nijiyome 1.1.0 for Linux and Windows, from the same code as the Android app.
First desktop build of Nijiyome (Kotlin Multiplatform): the Android app's screens on Linux and Windows.
